name: 伙食津貼 (meal allowance)
authority: 勞動基準法 §2(3) with 施行細則 §10: a monthly meal allowance (伙食津貼) is paid for work and is none of §10's exclusions, so it is 工資 — inside the insured salary (LI, EI, occupational injury, NHI, 勞退條例 §14 wage) and the §56 reserve wage. 營利事業所得稅查核準則 §88(2)(1) (amended 11 December 2023, from 1 January 2023; https://law-out.mof.gov.tw/LawContent.aspx?id=FL006027): 按月定額發給員工伙食代金…免視為員工之薪資所得 up to NT$3,000 a month, and the part above 應轉列員工之薪資所得 — so INCOME_TAX, INCOME_TAX_NON_RESIDENT, NHI_PART_TIME and NHI_SUPPLEMENT_EMPLOYER (all read 所得稅法 §14 薪資所得) take only the part above NT$3,000.

name: 全勤獎金 (full-attendance bonus)
authority: 全勤獎金 (full-attendance bonus): the amount is the contract's (keyed on the employment terms); the law only limits what leave may take from it. 勞工請假規則 §9 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030006&flno=9, in this form from 2026-01-01, read 2026-09-30): (1) 婚假、喪假、公傷病假及公假, 妊娠未滿三個月流產未請產假而請普通傷病假, and 依第七條 親自照顧家庭成員 事假 are not 缺勤 and cannot affect it; (2) other 普通傷病假 takes it only 按請普通傷病假日數依比例計算 — MOL Q&A (https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/28162/28166/28180/86983/87103/post, updated 2026-01-09): at most bonus ÷ 30 per sick day. 性別平等工作法 §21(2) likewise protects 生理假, 產假, 陪產檢及陪產假, 產檢假, 家庭照顧假 and the other §14–§20 leaves (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0030014). Owner rule 2026-09-28 defaults (law silent): each SICK_LEAVE, HOSPITALISED_SICK_LEAVE or ordinary PERSONAL_LEAVE (事假 not for family care, which the law leaves to the contract) working day in the window takes bonus ÷ 30, the deduction floored to the 元 so it never exceeds the ratio, never below nothing; every other leave takes nothing; an unpaid day does not prorate it again (`npl_prorates` false). A 2025-12 version applies the same arithmetic: before 2026 the rule protected fewer leaves but a pro-rata cut was always lawful. Not distinguished: a sick-leave day for a miscarriage under three months (§9(1)(2)) — record it as MATERNITY_LEAVE MISCARRIAGE_UNDER_2M / MISCARRIAGE_2M. It is 工資 (勞動基準法 §2(3): 經常性給與), so it enters the insured wages, the §56 reserve wage and 薪資所得 as the meal allowance does, without the meal exemption.

bands.amount: entry.amount - round(entry.amount * ((has(person.period.leave_days.SICK_LEAVE) ? person.period.leave_days.SICK_LEAVE : 0.0) + (has(person.period.leave_days.HOSPITALISED_SICK_LEAVE) ? person.period.leave_days.HOSPITALISED_SICK_LEAVE : 0.0) + (has(person.period.leave_days.PERSONAL_LEAVE) ? person.period.leave_days.PERSONAL_LEAVE : 0.0)) / 30.0, 1, 'DOWN') > 0.0 ? entry.amount - round(entry.amount * ((has(person.period.leave_days.SICK_LEAVE) ? person.period.leave_days.SICK_LEAVE : 0.0) + (has(person.period.leave_days.HOSPITALISED_SICK_LEAVE) ? person.period.leave_days.HOSPITALISED_SICK_LEAVE : 0.0) + (has(person.period.leave_days.PERSONAL_LEAVE) ? person.period.leave_days.PERSONAL_LEAVE : 0.0)) / 30.0, 1, 'DOWN') : 0.0
